name: Martial arts school

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.customer: Alex M. (a parent) and Mateo, 8 · other families and students

services.name: Free trial class
services.story: The main story: Mateo's free trial in Erin's Kids Beginner class, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am. Nothing is taken and no card is saved: a YES books it, and nothing is owed after. A member's class books the same way (covered by the membership).

services.name: Private lesson (30 min)
services.story: A $55 private lesson for Mateo with Erin (30 minutes), paid in full when booking. Single classes ($25), belt tests ($40) and a membership's first month are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the $55 may be kept, only with Sam's OK.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Diego and Tomas (instructors who go out)
B.customer: Alex M. (books for the office) · coworkers

services.name: Office self-defense class
services.story: The main story: a $179 self-defense class for up to 12 coworkers at Alex's office with Diego (60 minutes). A card is saved for the $89 late-cancel or no-show fee, and it's charged $179 when Diego texts DONE.

services.name: Office self-defense class
services.story: The same $179 class for a company, a school or a community center that pays by bill: nothing is taken to book, and Rosie texts the bill after.

services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: A $150 private lesson at home with Diego (60 minutes), paid in full when booking. With a child, a parent stays home for the whole lesson.

services_shape: class: a spot in a set class time by age group and belt, with a set number of spots, a set number of trial spots and a waitlist; each student booked is checked in on their own. A private lesson and a belt test are one instructor's time. Away from the school, an instructor teaches one group at the host's workplace, school or community center, booked whole by the host, or a private lesson at a home
questions_before_times: new to the school, or trained here before (sets the free trial and the waiver)
the age group (Little Tigers 4 to 6, Kids 7 to 12, Teens and Adults 13 and up), from the parent's words; the AI passes only the age group
trained before: style and belt (sets beginner or sparring)
a membership to use, if they have one
away: a workplace, a school, a community center or a home, and how many people (and if children will be there)
safety_stop: someone hurt or in danger right now
a child who talks about hurting themself
first_steps: Health notes, emergency contact and pick-up list
license: from the state form: teaching martial arts and self-defense usually needs no state license; some states register schools or clubs that sell memberships, and may ask for a bond for months paid ahead; personal training needs no license unless the state's form names one
staff_skills: kids' classes, sparring, self-defense, private lessons, belt testing; only black belts Sam names run belt tests; only instructors cleared for children teach them
messages_never: a child's age, health notes, injuries, incident notes and anything about bullying or behavior never go in a text or through the AI; texts to the owner or staff carry none either, only the first name, the last initial and a link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
